title: More ways to guide video generation
summary:
Seedance gained reference media, GLM-5.3 Flash joined the models, and finding the right model got less like guessing its name.

Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 gained GET-only reference image, video, and audio URL inputs, separate from start- and end-frame controls. The Playground also now enables reference-image uploads based on model capabilities instead of mistaking an unspecified upload limit for no support.

Added paid-only `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` with text and image input, tools, mandatory reasoning, and a 1,048,576-token context window. A separate guide update shows how to use the existing `reasoning_effort` parameter with models that support it.

Added 157 publisher-qualified model IDs as aliases; those IDs are planned to become canonical on September 7, 2026 at 14:00 UTC, while existing IDs remain aliases. The model catalog gained search filters for access, publisher, ID, type, and capability, plus autocomplete that helps chain filters.

highlights.title: Guide Seedance with media
highlights.text: Use `reference_images`, `reference_videos`, or `reference_audios` in GET requests to guide Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 video generation, separately from start- and end-frame images. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: GLM-5.3 Flash added
highlights.text: Try `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` for text and image input, tools, and reasoning, with a 1,048,576-token context window. It is a paid-only model. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=z-ai/glm-5.3-flash).

highlights.title: Publisher-qualified model IDs
highlights.text: You can use 157 publisher-qualified model IDs as aliases across text, image, audio, video, and other models. They are planned to become canonical on September 7, 2026 at 14:00 UTC; existing IDs will remain aliases. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Find models with filters
highlights.text: Search the model catalog by access, publisher, ID, type, or capability, and chain filters with autocomplete suggestions. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
